video_title: Toronto Raptors Media Availability | Pre Season vs Miami Heat | October 03, 2026

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on defensive discipline and rebounding struggles
quotes.excerpt: defensively, we forced them into 25 turnovers. There were moments that we were not disciplined
quotes.quote: We hit some very interesting lineups tonight out there. Obviously, with missing a couple guys with injuries, we had to also be mindful about the minutes of guys playing their first game coming back for a long break. Defensively, we forced them into 25 turnovers. There were moments that we were not disciplined when we need to get back on defense, when we need to pick up full court. That's something that we need to clean up from this game. Lost the rebounding battle, that was very important there, even we created 13 offensive rebounds. Offensively, obviously we did not shoot the ball well, 39 percent from the field and 29 percent from the three-point line. We talked about getting more shots, we got more threes tonight, we just got to make more shots.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic says the Raptors need to clean up defensive discipline and rebounding after forcing 25 turnovers but struggling to convert in their preseason opener against Miami.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on Scottie Barnes' role and offensive aggression
quotes.excerpt: I wish that he played a little bit with more force on offensive end to be honest
quotes.quote: That's going to be definitely work in progress. We cannot take away from his identity and what he brings to our team, which is hustle plays, rebounding, playing in the dunkers. He just needs to do a good job of recognizing when he needs to go and break the dunker and when he needs to be more in a pick and roll up high. I wish that he played a little bit with more force on offensive end to be honest with you. I'm used to seeing him playing more forceful, going to the rim, finishing above the rim. So that's something that we got to continue working on. I like that he got nine rebounds and that he was active on the glass tonight.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic wants to see more aggression from Scottie Barnes. I wish that he played a little bit with more force on offensive end to be honest with you. I am used to seeing him playing more forceful, going to the rim.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on Scottie Barnes' knee injury and performance
quotes.excerpt: he played with a lot of force, unfortunately he bumped his knee, so he was a little bit
quotes.quote: He played with a lot of force, unfortunately he bumped his knee, so he was a little bit cautious how much we were going to play him, especially in the second half. We didn't put him in the game there at all, but it was great seeing the force that he played with, that he was going downhill, playmaking in those situations. He was great.
quotes.social_post: Scottie Barnes was held out of the second half of the Raptors preseason opener after bumping his knee, according to Darko Rajakovic.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on the team's connection with Canadian fans
quotes.excerpt: our guys are aware of that, that they're not Toronto's team, they're just Toronto and but also belong
quotes.quote: This is such a privilege to be in Quebec City and to play in a sold-out arena and to see so many fans come and support. Definitely there is so much love over here for our team. Everywhere we go, our guys are aware of that, that they're not Toronto's team, they're just Toronto and but also belong to every city in Canada. So seeing that much love is very, very special.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on Scottie Barnes' three-point shooting and competitiveness
quotes.excerpt: I really liked the competitiveness that he brought there. There were moments he was guarding their five man
quotes.quote: He was excited to get his first three off and he was pretty hot from the three-point line. I really liked the competitiveness that he brought there. There were moments he was guarding their five man and there were matchups and I thought that he did not budge one moment, he did not retreat for one inch. I really liked the competitiveness there and I was telling him and all the guys, we got a green light. You guys got a green light to shoot the three ball. He had two situations when he put it on the floor and drove the ball instead of getting shot, but I thought that he did really well tonight.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic is encouraging his team to let it fly from deep. I was telling him and all the guys, we got a green light. You guys got a green light to shoot the three ball.
